About the Assessor’s Office
The responsibility of the Assessor is to discover, list, and value all tangible real and personal property within Iron County. This information is used to determine the assessed value of property for tax purposes.
GIS Mapping
The Iron County Assessor’s office uses a Geographic Information System (GIS) that can be viewed at semogis.com . The GIS is not intended for survey purposes — it is only a tool to inventory parcels for taxation.

Iron County
Iron County was organized on February 17, 1857 and named for the
abundance of iron ore found within its borders. The county seat is Ironton.
